title: Trump faces fresh setback as judge blocks stricter foreign student visa rule
content: the rule would have ended the decades-old system under which foreign students could remain in the country for the “duration of status” of their academic programme . a federal judge blocked a new rule that would have imposed stricter limits on how long foreign students and journalists can stay in the us .

title: Trump’s mail ballot push hits Supreme Court roadblock ahead of crucial midterms
content: the supreme court rejected his administration’s bid to impose new restrictions on mail-in voting ahead of the midterm elections . the ruling capped a flurry of legal action just weeks before voters decide which party will control Congress .

title: ‘Serious lapse’: Air India CEO summoned after 3 foreigners 'skip' immigration check
content: sources say the ministry of civil aviation has sought an explanation from the airline after the incident . the airline issued a show-cause notice to the airline over alleged procedural lapses . three italian nationals departed from Delhi without undergoing mandatory immigration clearance .

title: On Amit Shah's UCC implementation claim, 3 BJP allies sound caution
content: three BJP allies struck a circumspect note . a day after amit Shah expressed confidence that 21 NDA-governed states would implement Uniform civil code by 2029 . the parliamentary party leader of the telugu Desam party says it will speak with the home minister .

title: '3 Cong CMs invited to Brics dinner but they didn't turn up'
content: a day before the dinner, three CMs chose to skip the dinner . the dinner was hosted by govt . no political blame game has occurred over the issue, but there have been past incidents of blame game . a CM from BJP-governed states was also invited .

title: CBI files FIR in Disha Salian's death case after HC order
content: the court had criticised the police for failing to register an FIR . it has been filed under IPC sections covering offences such as gang rape, murder and destruction of evidence, etc. no one has been named as an accused in the case .

title: Voluminous evidence in graft cases leading to long pendency: SC
content: voluminous documents filed by the court are intimidating even to the court . court says many aspects attempted to be led in evidence are way off the mark . acquitting a person in a 33-year-old corruption case on the ground that CBI failed to prove that he received pecuniary advantage .

title: US rejects IRGC claim that Panama-flagged tanker hit naval mine
content: the Panama-flagged vessel was attacked by Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guards . the tanker was struck by an Iranian missile last month and rendered inoperable . CENTCOM describes the IRGC's "false claim" as another example of their lies and intimidation attempts .

title: J&K: Police bust LeT-linked OGW network, arrest 3 for aiding terrorists
content: the network allegedly linked with terrorist outfit Lashkar-e-Taiba . they allegedly provided logistical support, safe transit and other ground-level assistance to terrorists . the individuals, identified as Zakir Husaain, mohd Azam and Mohd Mustaq, are also suspected of having provided ground support to terrors linked with multiple high-profile attacks .

title: Monsoon withdrawal may begin this weekend: IMD
content: monsoon has reported a cumulative (June 1-Sept 14) rainfall deficit of over 14% this season . it is likely to start withdrawing from west Rajasthan this weekend . the deficit of more than 14% as of Monday shows that this year is more likely to end with a deficit of 10% or more - a deficient rainfall condition .
